'''Rowo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who operated the docking tower [[Rowo's Landing]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was covered in brightly-colored [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].
